en: A monochrome illustrated postcard depicting the assassination of a suited man in a simple interior room. The man, identified in the caption as Dr. António Granjo, stands near a bed or couch while a group of armed soldiers or militiamen surround him, aiming rifles and a pistol. One man in the center fires directly at him while others point their weapons from different angles. A tipped‑over chair lies in the foreground. On the right side of the postcard there is a printed vertical caption and explanatory text in Portuguese describing the scene as the death of António Granjo.
